Exampleshire Borough Council (202420001) - Housing Ombudsman
Source: https://www.housing-ombudsman.org.uk/decisions/exampleshire-borough-council-202420001/

Exampleshire Borough Council (202420001)
REPORT
COMPLAINT 202420001
Exampleshire Borough Council
4 March 2025
Our approach
Invented boilerplate sentence one for the plain-text fixture.
Invented boilerplate sentence two for the plain-text fixture.
The complaint
1. The complaint is about the council's handling of the resident's reports of damp and mould.
2. We have also considered the council's complaint handling.
Background
3. The resident holds a secure tenancy of a ground floor flat.
4. The resident reported mould in the living room in October 2023.
Assessment and findings
Scope of investigation
5. This investigation looks at events up to the council's final response.
The landlord's handling of the resident's reports of damp and mould
6. The council did not inspect for five months.
7. When it did inspect, it did not record the cause of the mould.
Complaint handling
8. The council's stage 2 response was late.
Determination
9. In accordance with paragraph 52 of the Scheme, there was severe maladministration in the council's handling of the resident's reports of damp and mould.
10. In accordance with paragraph 52 of the Scheme, there was maladministration in the council's complaint handling.
Orders and recommendations
11. Within 4 weeks of this report the council must pay the resident:
(a) £900 for the distress caused by its handling of the damp and mould;
(b) £200 for its complaint handling.
12. Evidence of compliance with these orders must be sent to the Ombudsman.
